description: Revises an article staged with cotal_draft_post. Use it to improve a draft or answer review notes: a changed title, dek or body becomes a new revision, identical text changes nothing, and base_revision refuses the write if someone revised it meanwhile. Returns the post's slug, status and current revision. Requires a team key (scope posts:write).

base_revision.description: The revision you edited; the write is refused (409) if the post moved past it.

body.description: The full new markdown body (not a diff).

note.description: One line on what this revision changes; shown in the revision history.

restore.description: Make an earlier revision current again instead of sending new text.

status.description: pending submits it for human review.

name: cotal_update_post

http_status.description: HTTP status of the underlying /v1 request (200, 201 or 202).

id.description: Id of the stored record, when one was created or found.

ok.description: true when the call was accepted.

rate_limit_remaining.description: Calls left in the current rate-limit window.

replayed.description: true when an Idempotency-Key retry returned the original record.

sandbox.description: true when this was a sandbox (dry-run) call and nothing was stored.

title: Revise a staged article
